method.stageFixtures: Synthetic gym and project levels, free injected test credits, collection minimum needed for the equipped items; not evidence of from-zero acquisition.
method.prices: Every marginal upgrade is dispatched through the real command, and level/gym gates are checked.
method.forecast: Exact stopping expectation for random XP; deterministic supply timing estimate. No target-template guarantee.
method.endurance: Purchase-now retains existing stamina; next-recruit scenario starts at the new capacity.
method.offline: One real athlete, 4-hour absence, no auto recommendation/recruitment; projects varying from 0 to the legal stage cap. Gym 6/8 supply profiles additionally test a real purchase of the +60-minute item, including any necessary slot upgrade.
method.recruitment: 128 default paired seeds, same recruitment/economy/attribute streams, balanced training, genuine matching and recommendation ledger probes at fixed levels; no equipment or birth rerolls.
method.equipmentSlots: Enumerated subsets of the strongest legally unlocked eight non-focus families. Fastest fixed-level forecast first, then business/offline diversity, not global strategy optimum.
method.scope: Single-athlete marginal effects shared by all trainees; cash payback and from-zero affordability require the separate journey audit.
